title: Describing Sets on the Real-Number Line

figureAlts.figure1.gif: A number line from -2 to 7. A blue segment is drawn from 1 to 3, with filled dots at 1 and 3 showing both endpoints are included. Another blue ray starts at 5 and extends to the right with an arrow showing it continues forever, with an open dot at 5 showing 5 is excluded.
